veranderings.na: In hierdie saak het hy in April 1964
veranderings.rede: 'Daar' points to a place, but the antecedent is a court case, so name the case to make the reference clear.

vlae.teks: Hierdie deel van sy verhaal gaan oor twee hofsake. Hy is in 1962 gearresteer. In 1963 het 'n ander hofsaak teen hom begin.
vlae.rede: The block announces two court cases, but only the arrest is mentioned before 'n ander hofsaak', so the first case is never stated and 'ander' has nothing explicit to contrast with; fixing it means stating the 1962 case, which is content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
